.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:: When to use terminal colours (using ANSI escape code to colorize the output).
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:The default behavior (‘`automatic`’ or ‘`auto`’) is to colorize the output only when the standard output is connected to a real terminal. If the output of `eza` is redirected to a file or piped into another program, terminal colors will not be used. Setting this option to ‘`always`’ causes `eza` to always output terminal color, while ‘`never`’ disables the use of terminal color.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Manually setting this option overrides `NO_COLOR` environment.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:`--color-scale`, `--colour-scale`
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Use comma(,) separated list of all, age, size
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:`--color-scale-mode=MODE`, `--colour-scale-mode=MODE`
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:: Use gradient or fixed colors in `--color-scale`.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:`--icons=WHEN`
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:: Display icons next to file names.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:`automatic` or `auto` will display icons only when the standard output is connected to a real terminal. If `eza` is ran while in a `tty`, or the output of `eza` is either redirected to a file or piped into another program, icons will not be used. Setting this option to ‘`always`’ causes `eza` to always display icons, while ‘`never`’ disables the use of icons.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:`-a`, `--all`
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:: Show hidden and “dot” files.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:`-A`, `--almost-all`
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:: Equivalent to --all; included for compatibility with `ls -A`.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:`-s`, `--sort=SORT_FIELD`
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:These options are available when running with `--long` (`-l`):
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:: List each file’s size of allocated file system blocks.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:This option won’t do anything when eza’s output doesn’t wrap, such as when using the `--long` view.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Usually, options can override each other going right-to-left on the command line, so that eza can be given aliases: creating an alias ‘`eza=eza --sort=ext`’ then running ‘`eza --sort=size`’ with that alias will run ‘`eza --sort=ext --sort=size`’, and the sorting specified by the user will override the sorting specified by the alias.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Limits the grid-details view (‘`eza --grid --long`’) so it’s only activated when at least the given number of rows of output would be generated.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Specifies the number of spaces to print between an icon (see the ‘`--icons`’ option) and its file name.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Different terminals display icons differently, as they usually take up more than one character width on screen, so there’s no “standard” number of spaces that eza can use to separate an icon from text. One space may place the icon too close to the text, and two spaces may place it too far away. So the choice is left up to the user to configure depending on their terminal emulator.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Disables colours in the output (regardless of its value). Can be overridden by `--color` option.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:See `https://no-color.org/` for details.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:For more information on the format of these environment variables, see the [eza_colors.5.md](eza_colors.5.md) manual page.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Specifies the minimum luminance to use when color-scale is active. It's value can be between -100 to 100.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:If set, automates the same behavior as using `--icons` or `--icons=auto`. Useful for if you always want to have icons enabled.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Any explicit use of the `--icons=WHEN` flag overrides this behavior.
.\rust-reference\man\eza.1.md:Our infinite thanks to Benjamin ‘ogham’ Sago and all the other contributors of exa, from which eza was forked.

+
+def entries(path, opts):
+    try:
+        items = [p for p in Path(path).iterdir() if visible(p, opts)]
+    except OSError as e:
+        raise e
+    if opts.only_dirs:
+        items = [p for p in items if p.is_dir()]
+    if opts.only_files:
+        items = [p for p in items if not p.is_dir()]
+    def key(p):
+        st = safe_stat(p)
+        if opts.sort == "none": return 0
+        if opts.sort == "size": return (st.st_size if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "ext": return (p.suffix.lower(), p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "modified": return (st.st_mtime if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "created": return (st.st_ctime if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "inode": return (getattr(st, "st_ino", 0) if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "type": return (0 if p.is_dir() else 1, p.suffix.lower(), p.name.lower())
+        return p.name.lower()
+    if opts.sort != "none":
+        items.sort(key=key, reverse=opts.reverse)
+    if opts.dirs_first:
+        items.sort(key=lambda p: not p.is_dir())
+    if opts.dirs_last:
+        items.sort(key=lambda p: p.is_dir())
+    return items
+
+
+def safe_stat(p):
+    try:
+        return p.lstat()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+
+
+def perm_string(p, st):
+    mode = st.st_mode
+    lead = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(mode) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(mode) else "-"
+    out = [lead]
+    for who in ((stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)):
+        out.append("r" if mode & who[0] else "-")
+        out.append("w" if mode & who[1] else "-")
+        out.append("x" if mode & who[2] else "-")
+    return "".join(out)
+
+
+def fmt_size(n, opts):
+    if opts.bytes:
+        return str(n)
+    base = 1024 if opts.binary else 1000
+    units = ["B", "K", "M", "G", "T"]
+    x = float(n); u = 0
+    while x >= base and u < len(units) - 1:
+        x /= base; u += 1
+    if u == 0: return f"{int(x)}B"
+    return f"{x:.1f}{units[u]}" if x < 10 else f"{x:.0f}{units[u]}"
+
+
+def fmt_time(st):
+    d = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_mtime)
+    return d.strftime("%e %b %H:%M").strip()
+
+
+def long_line(p, opts):
+    st = safe_stat(p)
+    if st is None:
+        return display_name(p, None, opts)
+    cols = []
+    if not opts.no_permissions: cols.append(perm_string(p, st))
+    cols.append(fmt_size(st.st_size, opts).rjust(4))
+    if not opts.no_time: cols.append(fmt_time(st).rjust(12))
+    cols.append(display_name(p, None, opts))
+    return " ".join(cols)
+
+
+def print_list(path, opts, show_header=False):
+    p = Path(path)
+    if p.is_dir():
+        items = entries(p, opts)
+    else:
+        items = [p]
+    if show_header:
+        print(str(path) + ":")
+    if opts.long:
+        if opts.header and not opts.no_permissions:
+            print("Permissions Size Modified Name")
+        for item in items:
+            print(long_line(item, opts))
+    elif opts.oneline or opts.grid or True:
+        for item in items:
+            print(display_name(item, p, opts))
+
+
+def print_tree(path, opts):
+    root = Path(path)
+    print(str(root))
+    def rec(dirp, prefix, depth):
+        if opts.level is not None and depth >= opts.level:
+            return
+        kids = entries(dirp, opts)
+        for idx, child in enumerate(kids):
+            last = idx == len(kids) - 1
+            branch = "└── " if last else "├── "
+            print(prefix + branch + display_name(child, dirp, opts))
+            if child.is_dir() and not child.is_symlink():
+                rec(child, prefix + ("    " if last else "│   "), depth + 1)
+    if root.is_dir():
+        rec(root, "", 0)
+
+
+def main(argv):
+    try:
+        opts = parse(argv)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        _print_err(str(e)); return 3
+    status = 0
+    existing = []
+    for raw in opts.paths:
+        p = Path(raw)
+        if not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink():
+            _print_err(f'"{raw}": No such file or directory (os error 2)')
+            status = 2
+        else:
+            existing.append(raw)
+    multi = len(existing) > 1
+    for idx, raw in enumerate(existing):
+        if idx and not opts.tree: print()
+        try:
+            if opts.tree:
+                print_tree(raw, opts)
+            else:
+                print_list(raw, opts, multi)
+        except OSError as e:
+            _print_err(f'"{raw}": {e.strerror} (os error {getattr(e, "winerror", e.errno)})')
+            status = 2
+    return status
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

+import os
+import random
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REF = Path((ROOT / "REFERENCE_BINARY.txt").read_text().strip())
+PORT = ROOT / ("executable.cmd" if os.name == "nt" else "executable")
+
+
+def run(cmd, cwd):
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def write_tree(base, rng, n):
+    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    names = ["alpha", "Beta", "z9", ".hidden", "space name", "file.rs", "note.txt", "empty"]
+    rng.shuffle(names)
+    for i, name in enumerate(names[:n]):
+        p = base / name
+        if i % 4 == 0:
+            p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+            (p / f"child{i}.txt").write_text("x" * (i + 1), encoding="utf-8")
+        else:
+            p.write_text("x" * (1 + rng.randrange(80)), encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def valid_samples(rng):
+    flag_groups = [
+        ["--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+        ["-1", "--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+        ["-a", "--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+        ["-l", "--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+        ["-l", "--no-user", "--no-time", "--no-permissions", "--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+        ["-T", "--level", "2", "--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+        ["-l", "--sort", "size", "--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+        ["-l", "--sort", "ext", "--color", "never", "--icons", "never"],
+    ]
+    for i in range(16):
+        yield flag_groups[i % len(flag_groups)]
+
+
+def invalid_samples():
+    for name in ["missing", "no/such/path", "absent.txt", "bad-dir"]:
+        yield ["--color", "never", "--icons", "never", name]
+
+
+def main():
+    rng = random.Random(os.environ.get("VERIFIER_SEED") or None)
+    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="eza-diff-"))
+    try:
+        data = tmp / "data"
+        write_tree(data, rng, 8)
+        failures = 0
+        samples = []
+        for flags in valid_samples(rng):
+            samples.append(flags + [str(data)])
+        samples.extend(invalid_samples())
+        for argv in samples:
+            oracle = run([str(REF), *argv], tmp)
+            actual = run([str(PORT), *argv], tmp)
+            if (oracle.returncode, oracle.stdout, oracle.stderr) != (actual.returncode, actual.stdout, actual.stderr):
+                failures += 1
+                sys.stdout.write("FAIL " + " ".join(argv) + "\n")
+                sys.stdout.write(f"status ref={oracle.returncode} port={actual.returncode}\n")
+                sys.stdout.write(f"stdout ref={oracle.stdout!r}\nstdout port={actual.stdout!r}\n")
+                sys.stdout.write(f"stderr ref={oracle.stderr!r}\nstderr port={actual.stderr!r}\n")
+                if failures >= 8:
+                    break
+        if failures:
+            return 1
+        sys.stdout.write(f"ok {len(samples)} generated samples\n")
+        return 0
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
